verdict.rationale: JumpCloud publishes an API 2.0 reference spec at docs.jumpcloud.com/api/2.0/index.yaml describing endpoints such as Graph traversal. It also keeps a GitHub support repo with API example scripts, so a reference and example code both exist. Nothing shows the reference is interactive or that examples run in the browser, and probes of common OpenAPI paths returned 404. Missing for 10: an interactive API explorer or try-it console, runnable in-docs examples, a discoverable OpenAPI endpoint, and hands-on corroboration.
